matching_css: .lbl { font: 700 15px var(--font); color: var(--c); letter-spacing: 2px; text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--c); }
#bar { position: absolute; left: 26px; right: 26px; bottom: 26px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; }
#speed { font: 900 64px/1 var(--font); color: #f2feff; text-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--c); margin-top: 4px; }
.lap { position: fixed; top: 22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; }
.lap .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
#time { font: 900 40px var(--font); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--c); letter-spacing: 1px; }
